    Class TpWari

    The custom <tp-wari> element displays Oware Abapa positions and plays out games and endgames.

    Example

    <tp-wari interactive=""></tp-wari>

    Tagname

    tp-wari

    Attr

    position = "S:4,4,4,4,4,4,4,4,4,4,4,4:0,0" - Side to move, twelve pit counts in sowing order, and South/North scores.

    Attr

    orientation = "south" - Side displayed at the bottom.

    Attr

    interactive = false - Enables human moves by clicking, tapping or keyboard. tp-wari-change Emitted after loading, playing or navigating a position.

    Eventdetail

    tp-wari-change { position: string; pits: number[]; scores: number[]; turn: string } tp-wari-move Emitted after a complete sowing turn and its captures.

    Eventdetail

    tp-wari-move { number: number; side: string; from: number; to: number; seeds: number; path: number[]; captures: { pit: number; seeds: number }[]; grandSlam: boolean; collected: number[]; before: string; after: string } tp-wari-end Emitted when a played move ends the game.

    Eventdetail

    tp-wari-end { position: string; result: string } tp-wari-error Emitted for invalid positions or play parameters; the previous game remains unchanged.

    Eventdetail

    tp-wari-error { message: string }

    Keyboard

    Arrow keys Move focus between pits in the displayed direction.

    Keyboard

    Enter / Space Sow the seeds of the focused legal pit when human input is enabled.

    Accessibility

    Numbered pit buttons expose seed counts and legal moves; scores and game status have text alternatives.

    See

    • tp-chess - Explore chess positions with the same playback controls.
    • tp-checkers - Explore international draughts positions with the same playback controls.
